newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Jan-Oct cement output rises 0.16 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Jan-Oct cement output rises 0.16 percent.

text.p: Peru's cement production during the first ten months of the year rose 0.16 percent to 3.136 million tonnes compared to the same period last year, the private Association of Cement Producers (ASOCEM) said monday.
In October, the country's cement production was 339,111 tonnes, the ASOCEM report said, without giving a comparative figure for 1995.
The biggest cement producer in the first ten months of 1996 was Cementos Lima with 1.337 million tonnes, followed by Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with 637,377 tonnes.
